overview: This item builds a more complex example where a behavior tree is one component within a larger Jido strategy or multi-strategy orchestration. The goal is to show how a behavior tree can be composed with other planning or control mechanisms (e.g., rule-based logic, direct actions, or HTN segments), and how its effects and signals integrate seamlessly with the rest of the system. The example should showcase coordination boundaries: where the larger strategy delegates to the tree, and how it responds to tree outcomes and signals. The work should highlight integration patterns such as using behavior tree signals to trigger higher-level strategy transitions, feeding shared state/blackboard via Jido schemas, and handling errors or aborts in a unified way. Tests and documentation should emphasize composability and reuse.
title: Create example: behavior tree as part of a larger strategy
